_about: Fixed lines every surface shares. A desk or a page can't rephrase them; change them here, read them aloud against specs/platform/voice.md, and every screen follows. {owner}, {person}, {site} and the like are filled with the template's replace filter.

visitor.disclosure: You're talking to AI. It never guesses prices, dates or allergens.
visitor.footer_ai: The WebAgents on this site are AI.
visitor.doesnt_say: The site doesn't say, so I won't guess.
visitor.resting: Answers are paused right now. The page and the form below still work.
visitor.frozen: Answers are paused right now. You can still read the site.
visitor.handover_person: Handed to {person} (a person). Their reply also appears here.
visitor.made_with_link: Get a free check of your own site

sample.band: {site} isn't a real business. It's a sample Agentrix runs to show the platform. Orders use PayPal's test mode, so no money moves and nothing is delivered.

decision.expired: This card expired before anyone answered. Nothing was done.
decision.superseded: A newer version of this card replaced it. Nothing was done from this one.

approve.title: Confirm it's you
approve.body: Your device signs exactly what is shown here. Nothing else can be approved with this signature.
approve.use_code: No passkey on this device? Use a code from your authenticator app
approve.signed: Signed. It runs once, and you get a receipt.
approve.failed: Your device didn't sign. Nothing was approved. Try again, or use a code.
approve.code_note: The code works once, and only for this approval. Your receipt will say a code approved it, not a passkey.

state.offline_banner: You're offline. You're seeing what was saved at {time}. Approvals wait until you're back online.
state.offline_action: You're offline. This waits until you're back online.
state.read_only: Read-only. {reason} You can still read and export everything.
state.frozen_owner: Frozen. Every WebAgent stopped at its next safe point. Your site keeps serving signed release {release}. Unfreeze needs your passkey.
state.models_resting: AI answers are resting: {reason}. Your site still serves its pages, and you can still edit by hand.

error.404_title: There's no page at this address
error.404_body: Check the address for a typo, or start again from the home page.
error.403_title: This page isn't open to you
error.403_body: You're signed in as {who}, and this account can't open it. Ask the owner to add you, or sign in with another account.
error.500_body: Something failed on our side, and nothing you entered was lost. Reload in a minute.
error.500_ref: If it keeps happening, quote reference {ref} to support.
